audit.whatIsWrong: The stored level chart gave Wukong five rows the prose itself calls even or skill-based: rows 2, 3, 5 and 6 read Wukong while whys[2] says 'Level 3 evens', whys[3] 'stay even', whys[5] and whys[6] 'skill-based'. Row 4 read Skill while whys[4] hands level 6 to Sejuani.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Wukong, Wukong, Skill, Skill, Sejuani, Skill, Skill] and matches the whys exactly; only the stored sides disagreed.
audit.corrected: Rows 2-6 flipped in both layers as one atomic group (Skill, Skill, Sejuani, Skill, Skill) with ratings brought down to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sejuani's spikes were never given numbers, so 'track Permafrost' had nothing behind it.
audit.why: Kit: Arctic Assault (Q) 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s, 650 range, knockup, stops on the first champion hit — her only gap-close. Winter's Wrath (W) 9/8/7/6/5s. Permafrost (E) 1.5s. Glacial Prison (R) 120/105/90s, 1300 range.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block rewritten around Winter's Wrath at 9s, Permafrost's 1.5s max-stack stun, and Arctic Assault at 18s as her only gap-close; Glacial Prison given its 120s and 1300 range in the level-6 phase.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two real errors. (1) The page repeatedly calls Permafrost a slow ('Permafrost slows', 'peel your dive with Permafrost slows'). Permafrost is a STUN and only fires on a target at maximum Frost stacks; the slow is Winter's Wrath, which is what applies the stacks. (2) Frost Armor is described as a source of slows — Riot's text says it grants Armor, Magic Resist and slow IMMUNITY.
audit.why: Riot text — E: 'freezes and stuns an enemy champion that has maximum Frost stacks.' W: 'slowing enemies and applying Frost stacks.' P: 'grants Armor and Magic Resist and immunity to slows... Sejuani can damage a stunned enemy to shatter it, dealing massive magic damage.'
audit.corrected: Count Frost stacks off Winter's Wrath and break off before the stack that lets Permafrost stun — the stun is also what unlocks her passive shatter burst. Plus the mirror's find: Glacial Prison reveals stealth, so Warrior Trickster's invisible dash does not break her vision on you.

audit.why: packet.suspectNames flags wants.foe[2] 'Land Glacial Prison' as a probable wrong name. It is a FALSE POSITIVE — Glacial Prison is Sejuani's real R in the kit file. No edit made.

edits.before: - Sejuani Permafrost: matchup-defining — Her stun after Frost stacks. Don't get stacked + stunned. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
